claims.detail: Committed exemplar: services invoke peers directly; edge hardening relies on per-service authz instead of a shared gateway.

findings.description: Calls fan out east-west across nine services without a centralized API gateway or WAF screening ingress JSON shapes.
findings.recommendation: Introduce an edge gateway for external consumers and standardize mTLS or signed service tokens internally.

findings.description: Blast radius grows because compromised credentials could traverse service-to-service paths before detection.
findings.recommendation: Pair segmentation controls with centralized correlation identifiers across all outbound HTTP clients.
